findings.detail: Actual code draws mutually independent discrete-uniform age, Bernoulli female and three lognormal variables. Fixed source means/individual SDs match admitted MIND anchors; female fraction is 2049/3547. Closed-form first/second moments independently checked. All continuous supports are positive; all positive-order moments are finite. No row matching, clipping, corrective resampling or file access occurs.

The product-law completion fixes all three population focal regression coefficients to zero. This is explicitly documented as an assumption, not published null evidence or target recovery. No nonmarginal E0 evidence exists, so empty numerical_uptake records are correct.

MIND age/selection/assay/imputation differences, prior-year BMI and transfer of its marginal anchors are explicitly unresolved. Jansen/Bao remain contextual. Matching source anchor moments algebraically is not source-population replay; all source comparisons remain unavailable.
The committed final decision retains the unchanged frozen initial candidate after its own trial feedback and requests no second exploratory attempt. No scientific revision improvement is claimed.

Individual dispersion is separated from external estimator, structural and transport uncertainty. Seed variation represents draws of a fixed law; it does not integrate the other uncertainty components or establish clinical/inferential validity.

Review inspected code, frozen metadata, deterministic analytic artifacts and the permitted generated-summary feedback. It did not import or execute the generator/fitter, create rows or read target reports/patient records. Source replay is unavailable. Author access compliance remains a retained-provenance claim under procedural host isolation.

review_method: Static code-to-law inspection, immutable-byte checks, independent closed-form scalar moment/projection/support arithmetic only; no fitter/generator invocation or target-quality threshold
mathematical_notes: Finite-sample designs can fail rank despite population identifiability; floating-point overflow remains a charged execution failure, never justification for hidden clipping or redraw.
scope: Readiness for the fixed three final seeds, not empirical validity, favorable source fit or target usefulness.
